name: MAK4I Savings Log Update Skill
description: Run at the end of every session to record token savings in the SAVINGS_LOG. Tracks what was reused, what was new, and the running total. This log is the production evidence that powers the MAK4I pre-seed pitch. Every entry is real data, not projections.
author: aswin@wdtechnologysolutions.com

content.command:
Update docs/MAK4I_SAVINGS_LOG.md with today's session. Ask Claude:

'Review this session. For the savings log, tell me:
1. Which existing artifacts were REUSED and how many tokens each saved
2. Which artifacts were ADAPTED and approximate tokens saved
3. Which NEW artifacts were created and their estimated future token savings per use
4. Today's session total tokens saved
5. New running total (previous total + today)

Format as a table row for the log.'

log_format.summary_update: Update the Summary table at the top of the log with new totals

reused.what: Existing artifact loaded and used without changes

adapted.what: Existing artifact used as a base but modified

new.what: Built from scratch — no existing artifact found

content.why_this_matters: The SAVINGS_LOG is Talvik's pre-seed evidence. Real numbers from real production use. Every logged session adds to the proof that MAK4I delivers measurable value. The goal: 12 months of data before the pre-seed pitch in late 2027.
content.honesty_rule: Never inflate token savings. Be conservative. An honest lower number is more credible than an optimistic higher one. Investors will scrutinize these numbers.
